Training Sources & Educational Context

At Sensei Sandy BJJ in Tannersville, NY, our coaching methodology is grounded in transparent, evidence-based practices. We maintain dedicated reference pages for the public health guidance, academic research, law enforcement data, and historical lineage that inform our curriculum.

Research & Local Evidence

Normalized verification records for direct BJJ studies, related-sport research, and time-sensitive Catskills activity sources.

View Research Records

CDC Physical Activity Guidance

Public health guidelines from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention regarding aerobic conditioning, strength building, and joint longevity for active adults over 30, 40, and 50.

View CDC Source

Marietta Police BJJ Study

Landmark research on mandatory Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu training for police officers in Marietta, Georgia, demonstrating a 48% reduction in officer injuries and a 53% reduction in suspect injuries.

View Study Context

Gracie Academy Background

Historical and structural foundation of beginner-class Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, positional control, self-defense principles, and cooperative learning frameworks.

View Academy History

Kenny Florian Lineage Profile

Technical lineage context connecting Sensei Sandy Nunez through 3rd-degree black belt Josh Griffiths (Clockwork BJJ NYC) to Kenny Florian and Roberto Maia.

View Lineage Profile

Why Transparent Sources Matter in Martial Arts

Many traditional martial arts schools rely on unverified claims or hyper-aggressive combat rhetoric. At Sensei Sandy BJJ, we take a different approach. Every class is designed as a coached learning experience built on clear biomechanical principles, practical risk-management habits, and calm, training plans.

Whether you are enrolling your child in our Kids BJJ Program, starting as an adult beginner in our Adults Program, or seeking specialized First Responder Training, our transparent foundation ensures you train with confidence from day one.

Start calm, train smart. Your first class is a structured, low-stress introduction.
